diagnostics.text: Potential electricity supply is abundant on paper but uncertain in delivery. Net planned generation additions total 227.6 GW through the pipeline horizon, while the active interconnection queue contains 2,061 GW, including 552.7 GW of storage. Only 24.2% of queued capacity has reached executed-agreement or construction stages; separately, 13% of the 2000–2020 queue cohort reached operation. Current reports provide two project-level approaches to power supply: PSEG plans a 200 MW nuclear uprate while eyeing data-center deals, and TerraVolt acquired an Idaho site for a planned 240 MW gas-powered, behind-the-meter campus. They remain individual proposals rather than evidence of aggregate delivery.

diagnostics.text: Financial markets are somewhat firmer, but investor attention remains on the economics behind expansion. The AI Equity Index increased to 36.4, 58.8% of covered companies have positive one-year returns, and the median return rose to 9.0%. Reuters reported that Anthropic’s soaring sales and steep losses could test enthusiasm in an IPO. Outside public markets, current business AI use remains at 24.6%, and only one tracked AI-linked labor channel has positive employment growth: power and communication construction, at 0.8%. Broader business deployment and employment gains therefore remain uneven.
